Agreements on import of oil
*183. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of agreements entered
into by India with other countries for the
import of oil and petroleum products for
the year 2004-05;
(b) whether there is any proposal for
buying oil and petroleum products on the
spot market; and
(c) if so, the quantum of oil proposed
to be purchased  under that arrangement
during the year 2004-05?

Universal Health Insurance Scheme
*181. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether he has recently launched a
Centrally heavily subsidized and the
cheapest redesigned Universal Health
Insurance Scheme (UHIS) targeting people
below poverty line;
(b) if so, the total amount earmarked
for UHIS;
(c) the maximum amount proposed to
be given  as compensation/reimbursement
of hospital expenses for diseases as well
as accidental injuries under this scheme;
and
(d) the details of the strategy for
marketing of this health insurance policy?
Investment in Special Deposit Scheme
*182. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
Minister of FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
has turned down the proposal of Central

aviation companies, Indian Airlines and Air
India, bear the expenditure on the training
of pilots trained by Indira Gandhi National
Flying Academy;
(b) if so, whether these pilots are
appointed only in these airlines companies
after completion of their training or they
are contracted by other  companies of
private sector; and
(c) the justification of the expenditure
made on their training by Indian Airlines
and Air India?
Parambikulam Aliyar Project
*185. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether action will be taken to
rectify the violations in the agreement in
the inter-State Parambikulam Aliyar Project
by Tamil Nadu Government;
(b) whether there is any representation by
the State Government of Kerala during the
year 2004 regarding violation in the clause
enshrined in the inter-State Parambikulam
Aliyar Project agreement; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Island Special Allowance
*186. SHRI ABDUL WAHAB
PEEVEE: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Island Special Allowance is
given only to the officers/staff  of the
nationalised banks who are posted from
mainland to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands;
(b) whether the officers/staff belonging
to these widely spread Islands are at times
on equal footing to their counterparts from
main land, if they are settled in one Island
and are posted at some far-flung Island
which often takes more time in travelling;
(c) what are the reasons for this
discrimination and how Government
propose to remove it; and
(d) what would be the financial burden
if this allowance is extended to Islanders?
Investment Commission
*187. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
Will the Minister  of FINANCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an Investment
Commission has been formed or being formed;
(b) if so, the details thereof such as its
constitution, terms of reference,
jurisdiction, etc.;
(c) whether it would be a Standing
Commission and submit recommendations
periodically; and
(d) if  not, whether it will be required to
submit its final report by the end of its term?
Increase in Government borrowings
*188. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Reserve Bank of India
has expressed concern  over the expected
increase in Government  borrowings during
the second half of the year;
(b) whether, according to a RBI report,
net Government borrowings stood at
Rs. 23,250 crores and the gross borrowings
at Rs. 75,050 crores forming 29 per cent
and 49 per cent of the budgeted amount,
respectively; and
(c) whether the RBI has cautioned
Government not to cross the fiscal deficit
target?

Godavari regions is being transported to

Rescheduling of flights during winter
1152. SHRI ANAND SHARMA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI  PREMA
CARIAPPA:
 Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a)  the details of steps taken by the AAI
and the DGCA to prevent  disruption and
diversion of flights from Delhi and North
Indian Airports due to fog in winter;
(b) whether there is any proposal for
diversion or rescheduling of the scheduled
Air India and Indian Airlines flights during
December-January; and
Concessions to senior citizens
1150. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether concessions in fare hitherto
given to senior citizens have become
meaningless with the imposition of new
rules by abolishing single fare tickets and
requiring advance bookings;
(b) if so, the reasons for imposing new
curbs on the travel by senior citizens; and
(c) whether a senior citizen unable to
travel at short notice is forced to pay full
fare under the existing rules?
Upgradation of airports
1151. SHRI C. PERUMAL:
SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
 Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that the civil
aviation sector is poised for overall growth
over the next three years;

255
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and the
details thereof?
Mandatory inspection of aircraft
1153. SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an Indian
Airlines plane bound for Mumbai recently
hit a tractor and took off without the
mandatory inspection;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken against the
responsible officers who did not adhere to
the mandatory inspection after this incident
thus endangering the lives of the
passengers?
Dilution of Government equity in IA
and AI
1154. SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
dilute their equity holding in both IA and
AI;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government also propose
to strengthen the existing fleet of these
carriers before going in for dilution;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the time likely to be taken in this
regard?
Recovery of dues from Travel Agents
1155. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SU. THIRUNAVUK-
KARASAR:
 Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that failure of
Indian Airlines to ensure proper and timely
remittance of dues has resulted in a
blockage of huge amount, which runs into
several crores of rupees, with the Travel
Agents authorised by it;
(b) if so, the details thereof as on today;
(c) how much amount is outstanding
against them for the last two years; and
(d) the details of steps taken to recover
the outstanding dues?
Equity support for AI and IA
1156. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI ANAND SHARMA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
 Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 1330 given in the Rajya Sabha
on the 17th August, 2004 and state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that Government
propose to increase the equity base of Air
India and Indian Airlines; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
anticipated time for its implementation?
Purchase of equity by AI and IA
1157. SHRI S.M.LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any policy to allow Indian
Airlines and Air India to buy shares in
private airlines;
(b) if so, the details of this policy;
(c) whether it is a fact that shareholding
in other airlines would give Indian Airlines
and Air India greater commercial spread
in the airline sector; and
(d) what steps Government  are taking

256
to ensure that the PSU airlines do not lose
their market dominance in the country?
Accident at Palam airport
†1158. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA:  Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether a security  officer of Sahara
Airlines was overrun by a bus of Jet
Airways near the runway of Palam airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the action taken by Government in
this regard;
(d) whether Government propose to
take any action to prevent this type of
accident; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Infrastructure facilities at airports

KSHATRIYA:  Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased
